images.caption:
This brick building known as New Gauge is the start of the New River with water pouring from the River Lea into the New River. 
Extraction of this water caused hostility with boatmen and mill-owners, who both claimed there was insufficient water in the Lea as a result.
Photograph by Stephen Dawson, 13 November 2004

images.filename: A subsidiary channel of the Old River Lea, Marshgate Lane - geograph.org.uk - 334418.jpg
images.caption: A subsidiary channel of the Old River Lea, Marshgate Lane Choked with weed, the view was taken from a bridge to one of the larger works west of Marshgate Lane. This will be incorporated into the Olympic Park. The industry will be relocated.The numerous channels of the River Lea flood plain provide a challenge to both engineers and landscape planners.
